args.body:
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to address CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays; high severity). 2.9.4 is the earliest fixed version in the 2.x line.

CI: passed (run ci-0001)
